# DataGridFilterMode

`Flare.Components.DataGridFilterMode`

Controls how column filters are displayed in the DataGrid.

## Values

| Name | Value | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Simple` | `0` | Show filter row with text inputs below headers (default). |
| `Menu` | `1` | Show filter icon in column headers that opens a dropdown with filter options. |

## Used by components

- `FlareDataGrid`
